scope: Centered fan and artistic vents pre-change candidate, original timestamps/hashes retained

geometry.json.scope: Exact OCCT solid booleans. Nonzero intentional seating contact is not permitted as overlap.
notVerified: specific HDD connector geometry and insertion depth

cartridgeLift.includes: Lid and attached top fan removed first. Exact internal printed pieces, five 9.5 mm HDD envelopes, rear fan/CM5/cooler design envelopes, four rear fan screw heads, conservative solid envelope of all native board components.
cartridgeLift.limitations: Discrete poses only. Zero overlap of conservative solid envelopes proves clearance at these poses; a nonzero envelope result needs exact-solid follow-up. Wiring, screw heads, solder tails and actual mating depths are excluded.

mating.json.scope: Exact B-rep nominal mating only. Printed shrinkage, warpage and fit feel are not measured.

mesh.json.scope: Exported binary STL edge topology and oriented volume. Does not prove self-intersection freedom, slicing, print supports or physical fits.

lidLift.scope: Discrete vertical poses, 1 mm steps to 16 mm and larger poses to 200 mm. Lid and complete top fan move together; no continuous swept-volume claim.

serviceReserve.scope: Empty geometric reserve only; actual connector, wiring and service slack are not modeled.

negativeControl.description: Old 92x25 fan, same upper mounting plane

limits: 92 mm fan total thickness must be <=14 mm including any supplied pads.
Generic fan envelope and rotor, not a measured purchased fan.
Disconnect power, initially lift lid, unplug fan, then remove lid. Connector and lift slack need physical verification.
M3 button-head x20, head <=5.7 diameter / 1.7 high, four OD7 x0.5 washers and AF5.5 x1.8 thin nuts; actual tools and fastening strength untested.
No thermal, airflow, acoustic, vibration, electrical header capacity or physical print-fit validation.

repository.json.sourceHtmlLinkBasis: src/index.html is a build template; local links are checked on generated index.html, and source main.mjs existence is checked.
repository.json.r2Builds: Dark full --audit and light build passed; historical R2 report bytes restored.
repository.json.r3Build: Absolute build.mjs from /tmp with bundled Node; final browser hashes match.

io-clearance.json.scope: Fresh native front-face planes and continuous straight gauges through the case wall. The USB-C open shell is checked by exact surface distance, not treated as a valid solid. The gauges are connector-mouth/tool envelopes; they do not model actual cable boots, latches, full insertion travel, button force/travel, or printing deviations.

materialGeometry.scope: B-rep material and contact geometry only; no stiffness, fatigue or vibration proof.

service-access.json.scope: Current exact spine/carriers/native board, 9.5 mm drive boxes. HDD and rear-fan fastening occur with shell absent. Top fan is fastened to a detached lid. Driver shaft is diameter 6 mm; fingertip is only a static diameter 14 mm short cylinder, not a hand model. M2.5x6 engagement assumes a 1.6 mm PCB and no washer. Does not prove heat-set insert fit, full hand access, wire route or physical assembly.

board-clearance.json.scope: Fresh exact B-rep cylinders. Support/head/tool exclude PCB seat contact; shanks also check PCB hole walls. Does not validate absent CM5/cooler/wifi, real solder tails, actual hardware/tool geometry or printed fits.
